wrong_turns: Risk, not observed: assuming the low ledges are merely collectible routes could miss their stated hiding use.
Risk, not observed: stepping into the moving bomb or leaving PAC OPEN too soon may interrupt the crossing; consequence and recovery have not been seen.
unknowns: Bomb collision effect, blast radius, damage or reset consequence are unknown; the moving object alone does not prove a physical hazard score.
Whether hiding or platform riding is mandatory, whether the ground route is otherwise sufficient, and whether both heroes must jump are unverified.
The seven-second power cycle is stated, but no full cycle or mandatory powered movement is observed.
Gate persistence and a failed crossing retry are unobserved.
No player game-key actions were witnessed; all proposed steps and their feedback are hypotheses, not a demonstrated legal route.
Shared-keyboard input reliability and simultaneous key registration were not tested. A single operator would also have to switch between two control sets; this is outside the two-human baseline.
Collectibles are optional and excluded from the mandatory estimate; their displayed count does not establish required reasoning or execution.
Earlier exposure is only an opportunity to learn; no prior human mastery is established.
